agent-platform.purpose: Daytona workspace initialization template (staging directive Option B)
notes: Daytona mounts /nix/store read-only and protects permissions out of the box when the sandbox is booted from a snapshot captured from this template.

The shallow nixpkgs git clone in postCreateCommand is deliberate: the tarball flake/channel route goes through nix's tarball-to-git-cache conversion, which the cgroup OOM killer terminates on 1GB sandboxes (verified live 2026-09-10).
Self-hosted Daytona (Hetzner CAX11, 4GB+) evaluates full nixpkgs without constraints; this template works identically there.
